replies.author: Bluecichlid
replies.body:
I'm honestly 100% opposed to this suggestion. The gameplay mechanics of Nebula are currently fantastic, and for me, kits would ruin the integrity of the game.

Edit: Don't be put off by our negative feedback, suggestions are always welcome.
